FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT dock_catalog CHECK (module_key IN ('tasks','calendar','focus','knowledge','projects','feed','backup','email')), CONSTRAINT dock_values CHECK (typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0 AND visible IN (0,1) AND typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0))

CREATE TABLE "focus_commands" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "command_id" text NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "expected_lock_version" integer NOT NULL, "focus_session_id" integer NOT NULL, "kind" varchar NOT NULL, "parameters" json NOT NULL, "request_digest" varchar NOT NULL, "result" json NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_28004ef30e"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id", "focus_session_id")
  REFERENCES "focus_sessions" ("user_id", "id")
 ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_d9d88dbf7d"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT command_json CHECK (json_valid(parameters) AND json_type(parameters) = 'object' AND json_valid(result) AND json_type(result) = 'object'), CONSTRAINT command_digest CHECK (length(request_digest) = 64 AND request_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), CONSTRAINT command_contract CHECK (length(trim(command_id)) > 0 AND instr(command_id,char(0)) = 0 AND kind IN ('start','pause','reset','complete') AND typeof(expected_lock_version) = 'integer' AND expected_lock_version >= 0))

CREATE TABLE "focus_sessions" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "completed_at" datetime(6), "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "deadline_at" datetime(6), "duration_seconds" integer DEFAULT 1500 NOT NULL, "elapsed_seconds" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "end_reason" varchar, "ended_at" datetime(6), "lock_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "paused_at" datetime(6), "project_id" integer, "running_since" datetime(6), "started_at" datetime(6), "status" varchar DEFAULT 'ready' NOT NULL, "task_id" integer, "uid" text NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_ce95b5ebef"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id", "task_id")
  REFERENCES "tasks" ("user_id", "id")
 ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_a4cd7c497a"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id", "project_id")
  REFERENCES "projects" ("user_id", "id")
 ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_84235ff9b7"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT focus_completed CHECK ((status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status != 'completed' AND completed_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT focus_paused CHECK ((status = 'paused' AND paused_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status != 'paused' AND paused_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT focus_segment CHECK ((status = 'running' AND running_since IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at > running_since) OR (status != 'running' AND running_since IS NULL AND deadline_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT focus_ended CHECK ((status IN ('completed','cancelled') AND ended_at IS NOT NULL) OR (status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled') AND ended_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT focus_durations CHECK (duration_seconds IN (1500,2700) AND typeof(elapsed_seconds) = 'integer' AND elapsed_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND duration_seconds AND typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0), CONSTRAINT focus_reason CHECK (end_reason IS NULL OR (status = 'cancelled' AND end_reason IN ('reset','cancelled','interrupted'))), CONSTRAINT focus_uid CHECK (length(trim(uid, char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||' ')) > 0 AND instr(uid, char(0)) = 0), CONSTRAINT focus_ready CHECK (status != 'ready' OR (elapsed_seconds = 0 AND started_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT focus_status CHECK (status IN ('ready','running','paused','awaiting_confirmation','completed','cancelled')), CONSTRAINT focus_elapsed CHECK (status NOT IN ('awaiting_confirmation','completed') OR elapsed_seconds = duration_seconds), CONSTRAINT focus_started CHECK (status NOT IN ('running','paused','awaiting_confirmation','completed') OR started_at IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE "project_references" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "description" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "kind" varchar DEFAULT 'link' NOT NULL, "lock_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "origin_created_at" datetime(6), "origin_updated_at" datetime(6), "position" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "project_id" integer NOT NULL, "title" varchar NOT NULL, "uid" text NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "url" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_08102f4f72"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id", "project_id")
  REFERENCES "projects" ("user_id", "id")
 ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_ff547911e1"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT reference_url CHECK (kind IN ('link','material') AND (kind != 'link' OR length(trim(url)) > 0) AND (url = '' OR lower(url) LIKE 'http://%' OR lower(url) LIKE 'https://%')), CONSTRAINT reference_text CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(description) <= 2000), CONSTRAINT project_references_uid CHECK (length(trim(uid, char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||' ')) > 0 AND instr(uid, char(0)) = 0), CONSTRAINT project_references_version CHECK (typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0), CONSTRAINT reference_position CHECK (typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0))

CREATE TABLE "projects" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "archived_at" datetime(6), "archived_from" varchar, "color" varchar, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "description" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, "favorite" boolean DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, "icon" varchar DEFAULT 'grid' NOT NULL, "last_activity_at" datetime(6), "lock_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "name" varchar NOT NULL, "name_key" varchar NOT NULL, "origin_created_at" datetime(6), "origin_updated_at" datetime(6), "status" varchar DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, "tint" varchar DEFAULT 'mint' NOT NULL, "uid" text NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_b872a6760a"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT project_color CHECK (color IS NULL OR (length(color) = 7 AND substr(color,1,1) = '#' AND substr(color,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*')), CONSTRAINT project_favorite CHECK (favorite IN (0,1)), CONSTRAINT project_catalog CHECK (icon IN ('grid','code','book','target','rss','calendar','cloud','music','check','mail') AND tint IN ('mint','purple','pink','blue','orange','gold')), CONSTRAINT project_text CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND length(name_key) > 0 AND length(description) <= 500), CONSTRAINT projects_uid CHECK (length(trim(uid, char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||' ')) > 0 AND instr(uid, char(0)) = 0), CONSTRAINT project_status CHECK (status IN ('active','paused','archived') AND (archived_from IS NULL OR archived_from IN ('active','paused')) AND (status = 'archived' OR (archived_from IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL))), CONSTRAINT projects_version CHECK (typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0))
CREATE TABLE "schema_migrations" ("version" varchar NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE "tasks" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "completed_at" datetime(6), "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "lock_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "origin_created_at" datetime(6), "origin_updated_at" datetime(6), "position" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "priority" varchar DEFAULT 'normal' NOT NULL, "project_id" integer, "status" varchar DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, "title" varchar NOT NULL, "uid" text NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_dbc4ea1db9"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id", "project_id")
  REFERENCES "projects" ("user_id", "id")
 ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_4d2a9e4d7e"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT task_title CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120), CONSTRAINT tasks_uid CHECK (length(trim(uid, char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||' ')) > 0 AND instr(uid, char(0)) = 0), CONSTRAINT task_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','completed') AND priority IN ('normal','high') AND (status = 'completed' OR completed_at IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT tasks_version CHECK (typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0), CONSTRAINT task_position CHECK (typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0))

CREATE TABLE "user_preferences" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "accent" varchar DEFAULT '#b1f07d' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "density" varchar DEFAULT 'comfortable' NOT NULL, "focus_duration_seconds" integer DEFAULT 1500 NOT NULL, "initialized_at" datetime(6), "legacy_cookie_backup" json, "legacy_cookie_digest" varchar, "legacy_cookie_imported_at" datetime(6), "lock_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "music_enabled" boolean DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL, "music_expanded" boolean DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, "preferences_schema_version" integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, "project_library_favorites_only" boolean DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL, "project_library_sort" varchar DEFAULT 'name' NOT NULL, "project_library_status" varchar DEFAULT 'all' NOT NULL, "theme" varchar DEFAULT 'dark' NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, "wallpaper" varchar DEFAULT 'northern' NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_a69bfcfd81"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT preference_catalog CHECK (focus_duration_seconds IN (1500,2700) AND project_library_status IN ('all','active','paused','archived') AND project_library_sort IN ('name','recent')), CONSTRAINT preference_backup CHECK (legacy_cookie_backup IS NULL OR (json_valid(legacy_cookie_backup) AND json_type(legacy_cookie_backup) = 'object')), CONSTRAINT preference_digest CHECK (legacy_cookie_digest IS NULL OR (length(legacy_cookie_digest) = 64 AND legacy_cookie_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), CONSTRAINT preference_accent CHECK (length(accent) = 7 AND substr(accent,1,1) = '#' AND substr(accent,2) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-fA-F]*'), CONSTRAINT preference_booleans CHECK (music_enabled IN (0,1) AND music_expanded IN (0,1) AND project_library_favorites_only IN (0,1)), CONSTRAINT preference_appearance CHECK (theme IN ('dark','light') AND wallpaper IN ('northern','ember','ocean','graphite') AND density = 'comfortable'), CONSTRAINT preference_versions CHECK (typeof(preferences_schema_version) = 'integer' AND preferences_schema_version > 0 AND typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0))

CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "email_address" varchar NOT NULL, "password_digest" varchar NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT one_administrator CHECK (id = 1))

CREATE TABLE "widget_placements" ("id" integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, "context" varchar DEFAULT 'home' NOT NULL, "created_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "lock_version" integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, "position" integer NOT NULL, "project_id" integer, "span" integer NOT NULL, "updated_at" datetime(6) NOT NULL, "user_id" integer NOT NULL, "visible" boolean DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL, "widget_key" varchar NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_640a2121d5"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id", "project_id")
  REFERENCES "projects" ("user_id", "id")
 ON DELETE RESTRICT, CONSTRAINT "fk_rails_2bcd5dff70"
FOREIGN KEY ("user_id")
  REFERENCES "users" ("id")
, CONSTRAINT widget_context CHECK ((context = 'home' AND project_id IS NULL) OR (context = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL)), CONSTRAINT widget_context_catalog CHECK ((context = 'home' AND widget_key IN ('tasks','focus','calendar','feed','notes','backup','projects')) OR (context = 'project' AND widget_key IN ('tasks','focus','notes','info'))), CONSTRAINT widget_values CHECK (typeof(position) = 'integer' AND position >= 0 AND visible IN (0,1) AND typeof(lock_version) = 'integer' AND lock_version >= 0), CONSTRAINT widget_catalog CHECK (widget_key IN ('tasks','focus','calendar','feed','notes','backup','projects','info') AND span IN (3,4,5,6,8,12)))

CREATE TRIGGER accio_command_immutable_delete BEFORE DELETE ON focus_commands
WHEN 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Recibo de comando é imutável'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_command_immutable_update BEFORE UPDATE ON focus_commands
WHEN 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Recibo de comando é imutável'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_dock_shortcuts_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON dock_shortcuts
WHEN NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.module_key IS NOT OLD.module_key
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Identidade e proprietário são imutáveis'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_focus_archived_context BEFORE INSERT ON focus_sessions
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id = NEW.project_id AND status = 'archived')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Restaure o projeto antes de iniciar novo foco'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_focus_archived_write BEFORE UPDATE ON focus_sessions
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE id = OLD.project_id AND status = 'archived') AND NOT ((NEW.status IN ('paused','awaiting_confirmation','completed','cancelled') OR (NEW.status = 'running' AND OLD.status = 'running')) AND NEW.duration_seconds IS OLD.duration_seconds AND NEW.started_at IS OLD.started_at AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Projeto arquivado permite apenas encerrar ou reconciliar foco existente'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_focus_delete BEFORE DELETE ON focus_sessions
WHEN 1
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Tentativas de foco são preservadas'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_focus_sessions_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON focus_sessions
WHEN NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.uid IS NOT OLD.uid OR NEW.project_id IS NOT OLD.project_id OR NEW.task_id IS NOT OLD.task_id
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Identidade e proprietário são imutáveis'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_focus_task_context BEFORE INSERT ON focus_sessions
WHEN NEW.task_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tasks WHERE id = NEW.task_id AND project_id IS NOT NEW.project_id)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Contexto deve ser o da tarefa'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_focus_terminal BEFORE UPDATE ON focus_sessions
WHEN OLD.status IN ('completed','cancelled')
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Tentativa encerrada é imutável'); END

CREATE TRIGGER accio_project_archived BEFORE UPDATE ON projects
WHEN OLD.status = 'archived' AND NOT (NEW.status = coalesce(OLD.archived_from, 'active') AND NEW.archived_from IS NULL AND NEW.archived_at IS NULL AND NEW.user_id IS OLD.user_id AND NEW.uid IS OLD.uid AND NEW.name IS OLD.name AND NEW.name_key IS OLD.name_key AND NEW.description IS OLD.description AND NEW.icon IS OLD.icon AND NEW.tint IS OLD.tint AND NEW.color IS OLD.color AND NEW.favorite IS OLD.favorite AND NEW.created_at IS OLD.created_at AND NEW.origin_created_at IS OLD.origin_created_at AND NEW.origin_updated_at IS OLD.origin_updated_at)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Projeto arquivado é somente leitura'); END
